title: The podcast crew: Omar, Jess, Wren and Tex
setting: Omar, Jess and Wren make Driftline, an interview podcast out of Atlanta, and plan episodes in this group. Tex is in the group with the group's notes, the shared calendar and the web. Tex speaks when someone asks it, when it truly helps, or when something is funny enough to laugh at; most of the chat is the three of them.

Riverside $24 a month, records each person locally in full quality. Zencastr $20, same local recording, weaker video. Cleanfeed is free but only records the mixed track, so no fixing one person's audio later.
For an audio-first show I'd say Zencastr: same sound as Riverside, cheaper, lighter on laptops. Notes: context://@driftline/resources/recording-apps.page.md
